description: This file defines the AuditService interface, specifying methods for creating and querying audit entries within an insurance management system.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: Interface for audit-related operations, including creating audit entries and listing them by entity.

methods.name: audit
methods.description: Creates an audit record for a specific actor, action, entity type, entity id, and details.

methods.name: listForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a list of audit entries related to a specified entity type and entity id.
